item.description: Role and ownership checks: guides only see their own tours, partners only their assigned orders.

request.description: Sign in as a guide; the response is automatically scoped to tours owned by that guide.

  "destination_id": "{{destinationId}}",

}

request.description: Sign in as a partner; only orders assigned through /admin/orders/{id}/partner are returned.
